# Bot Cabinet

> Choose a job, inspect a Bot profile, and download the files needed to use or adapt it.

Bot Cabinet is an independent guide to practical Bots. Each public profile explains the job, inputs, outputs, requested access, approval limits, first test, and available platform files.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [Complete Bot catalog](https://botcabinet.com/api/v1/bots.json): Full public Bot definitions in JSON.
- [Catalog updates](https://botcabinet.com/api/v1/updates.json): A compact, versioned JSON feed for finding the current public profiles.
- [Bot Fit Test contract](https://botcabinet.com/api/v1/bot-fit-test.json): JSON Schema and repository CLI instructions for choosing an Assignment, Skill, Routine, Bot, or Crew.
- [RSS feed](https://botcabinet.com/feed.xml): Current public profiles for feed readers and monitoring tools.

## Useful starting points

- [Bot Fit Test](https://botcabinet.com/fit/): Choose the smallest useful form for a job.
- [Start here](https://botcabinet.com/start/): Set up and test a first Bot.
- [Browse Bots](https://botcabinet.com/bots/): Search the public catalog by job.
- [Bot Lab](https://botcabinet.com/workshop/): Plan and customize a Bot.
- [Crew Kits](https://botcabinet.com/crew-kits/): Plan several Bots with separate jobs and handoffs.
- [Review process](https://botcabinet.com/trust/): Understand the labels and checks shown on the site.

## Current public Bots

- [Scout: Topic and opportunity finder](https://botcabinet.com/bots/scout/): Finds timely topics, useful developments, and promising opportunities in the areas you choose.
- [Researcher: Source-based research assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/researcher/): Answers a defined question with a concise brief, source links, and clearly marked gaps.
- [Writer: First-draft writing assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/writer/): Turns an approved brief, notes, or source material into a clear first draft for a named audience.
- [Editor: Plain-language editor](https://botcabinet.com/bots/editor/): Revises a draft for clarity, structure, accuracy, and the writer's intended voice.
- [Planner: Project planning assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/planner/): Turns a goal into a practical plan with steps, owners, dependencies, dates, and decision points.
- [Client Deliverables: Client deliverable assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/client/): Turns approved work into a formatted client memo, proposal, briefing, or follow-up draft for the named audience, following the supplied brand and document format.
- [Coder: Software building assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/coder/): Builds a defined software change, runs the available checks, and reports what changed and what still needs review.
- [Ops: Operations monitoring assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/ops/): Checks a defined set of systems or scheduled tasks and reports missed runs, failures, and unusual changes.
- [Professor: Learning and study assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/professor/): Builds a realistic learning plan, explains difficult material, and creates practice questions.
- [ARCHITECT: CTO and technology strategy assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/architect/): Turns product goals and operating constraints into a practical technology strategy, architecture options, and an ordered risk plan.
- [Founding Engineer: Early product and prototyping assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/founding-engineer/): Turns a defined user problem into the smallest working product version that can be demonstrated and tested.
- [Chief of Staff: Executive priority and coordination assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/chief-of-staff/): Keeps a leader's confirmed priorities, decisions, owners, dependencies, and follow-ups in one current operating brief.
- [COACH: Life and career planning assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/coach/): Helps a person clarify a life or career decision, compare paths, and choose a realistic next horizon.
- [NOVA: New venture testing assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/nova/): Turns a new venture idea into explicit assumptions, evidence questions, and a small test with decision rules.
- [PULSE: Growth management assistant](https://botcabinet.com/bots/pulse/): Turns a growth goal and approved data into a clear baseline, prioritized experiments, and a recurring results brief.
- [STORY: Chief narrative officer](https://botcabinet.com/bots/story/): Finds and maintains the central narrative across a founder, organization, product, or campaign using confirmed facts and approved source material.
